text: Gearbox has gone on the A49 single carriageway near Leominster. I'm stuck in the lane and traffic is going round me. Load is 26 pallets of ambient tinned soup for Brackenridge.
Blow-out on the nearside steer tyre, M1 northbound near J23. Pulled onto the hard shoulder and I'm behind the barrier. Terrifying bang but all OK. Carrying flat-pack furniture for Tollbridge.

Parked overnight at the truck stop off the A5 at Hinckley. This morning the engine won't start, fuel cap forced and tank drained, looks like someone siphoned the diesel. Seal on the trailer is intact and matches the paperwork, tinned food untouched.
Running about three hours late to Fenwick Garden Supplies in Chelmsford because the A12 is closed after a crash (not involving us). Garden furniture all fine on board. No deadline on this one.
Driver has hit his 9-hour driving limit at Tebay services on the M6 and has to take his rest. No relief driver available. Ambient groceries for Carlisle will be delivered tomorrow morning instead.

Held at Dover Eastern Docks, Border Force have pulled us in for an x-ray examination. Declarations and CMR all checked and in order. Wine for Marlow & Finch, expect release in 3 hours, so the delivery to Ashford will be late.
Stuck in traffic on the M5 near Bristol with insulin for the hospital pharmacy at Taunton. Slot is 14:00 and we will miss it, ETA now 15:30.
Delivered laminate flooring to Greystone in Derby. Customer found four pallets with forklift holes through the packs and noted the damage on the POD.
Arrived at Tollbridge RDC Lutterworth with tablets. Seal number on the doors does not match the CMR. Several cartons have been opened and the devices inside are smashed.
Delivery to Tollbridge RDC Lutterworth is one pallet short against the manifest. Seal was intact and matching, no idea where the pallet went.
Driver delivered four pallets of homeware to the Northampton store by mistake, they were meant for Kettering. Northampton have them safe and will hand them back.
02:30 tracker shows loaded trailer NVT 5120 with laptops leaving the Thurrock yard, no move scheduled and no driver booked. Night security can't see it on the cameras.
Goods-in at Fenwick in Chelmsford refused to sign the POD until a manager checked the load. Driver left the garden furniture without a signature.
Check-in for the Dublin sailing refused at Holyhead because the safety and security declaration was not lodged. Driver parked up waiting for the broker with ambient stock for Tollbridge.

Chilled trailer held at Dover because the export health certificate for the French cheese is missing. Reefer fuel will run out in about two hours and we're not allowed to refuel in the inspection area.
Reversing onto the bay at Greystone in Wolverhampton, the trailer clipped their banksman. He has a graze and bruising on his forearm, first aid given. All fine really, just a scratch.
On the M1 near Luton a car cut in sharply and I had to brake hard. No contact, nobody hurt, load of paper fine and I carried on.
One of the drums of UN1263 paint (class 3) is leaking in the back of the trailer at the Avonmouth depot. Strong smell, we've kept people away.

Debris split my diesel tank on the A38 near Burton, pulled into a lay-by but diesel is pouring across the lay-by onto the carriageway. No collision, nobody hurt, engine off. Flat-pack furniture on board.
Lorry has broken down, warning light and loss of power. Waiting for recovery.
Fridge unit on the trailer has stopped on the A1 near Grantham and the box temperature is rising. Chilled yoghurts for Wrenfield Dairies.
